body:
PRE-EDIT SIBLING SWEEP — scope should be the whole public SinkhornConfig boundary, still only the same two proposed paths. No claim, reservation, or production edit.

RUN, do not infer: disposable ordinary clone at exact main e4bbf5b; one focused probe, 1/1 green, printed consequences from UnbalancedSinkhorn.solve on a 2x2 finite problem.

- epsilon=NaN -> Right(all-zero plan), 200 iterations, converged=false.
- epsilon=+Inf -> Right(all-ones plan), 1 iteration, converged=true.
- rhoRows/rhoCols = NaN or +Inf -> Right(all-zero plan), 200 iterations, converged=false.
- tolerance=NaN, 0, or -1 -> ordinary-looking nonzero plan, 200 iterations, converged=false.
- tolerance=+Inf -> premature one-iteration converged=true plan.
- maxIterations=0 -> unoptimized exp(-cost/epsilon) kernel, 0 iterations, converged=false.

REACHABILITY: SinkhornConfig is a public case class and solve receives it directly; every probe is one public construction, no upstream gate. CONSEQUENCE: some failures are detectably non-converged, but +Inf epsilon/tolerance claim convergence over materially wrong early plans. This is one validator whose advertised job is rejecting invalid configuration, not separate algorithms.

PROPOSED WIDENING, no new paths/vocabulary: solve rejects non-finite epsilon/rhoRows/rhoCols/tolerance; requires epsilon>0, penalties>=0, tolerance>0, maxIterations>0; returns existing AlignError.InvalidConfig. Two aggregate laws name the rejected parameter labels so reverting to the old guard exposes every surviving sibling, not only the first. Mutation old guard should make both new laws red while existing plan laws remain green. Same scoped gate as proposed. Chief: approve/adjust this two-path whole-config boundary.
